name: issue_593_column_collation
description: Test case for explicit non-default column collations being omitted from dump output (GitHub issue #593)
notes: Reproduces the bug where COLLATE on a column was dropped, so the recreated column and its indexes silently used the database default collation
Tests that COLLATE is emitted only when it differs from the data type's default collation
Tests that an index inheriting the column collation stays unchanged
